title: Before the Modern World: Ancient and Medieval Histories
summary: A connected, evidence-aware history of the world from early urban societies to around 1500 CE, organized by periods and intersecting regional histories.
assumed_background: No specialist historical knowledge; places, time periods, institutions and sources are introduced as needed
